findings.text: Fragmentation scoring for a zone and order is obtained by gathering free block statistics and then deriving a single score from them.
Free statistics cover every order and accumulate total blocks and total base pages weighted by order size, plus suitable blocks normalized to the requested order.

The index reports zero for an oversized order or no free memory, a distinct large negative value when a suitable block exists, otherwise a milli scaled value where low means scarcity and high means scattering.
Scale facts observed are negative one thousand for satisfiable, zero for empty or invalid, and zero to one thousand for the fragmented case.
Compaction aware reclaim applies only with compaction allowed and nonzero order combined with either a costly order or priority well below default.

Node memcg reclaim selects full or partial tree coverage, iterates groups with scheduling tolerance, refreshes protection, skips hard protected groups and conditionally soft protected groups, reclaims each eligible group, records efficiency feedback, and can stop early once the goal is met.
Per eligible group the walker reclaims the node vector and then slab at current priority, and unless proactive folds the scanned and reclaimed deltas into pressure feedback.
Memcg protection update is inert when disabled, substitutes the global root for a null root, and delegates to counter logic with a hierarchy derived flag.

Counter protection is inert for the root itself or zero usage. A direct child copies configured minimum and low. Deeper counters derive effective minimum and low from usage and parent state and sibling totals.

Effective protection scales shares by utilization when siblings exceed the parent allowance. Otherwise the base is claimed use capped by setting, with optional recursive distribution of unclaimed parent allowance weighted by unprotected use.
Compaction readiness is false when the mode forbids compaction, true when the zone already meets the minimum watermark or looks suitable at a higher watermark, otherwise false.

Reclaim throttling wakes no progress waiters when efficiency is above about one eighth, exempts kswapd and cgroup reclaim from that throttle, and otherwise throttles only at the lowest priority with nothing reclaimed.
Refault snapshotting is skipped in one generation state and otherwise copies current anonymous and file activation counts into the target vector slots.
This memcg reclaim variant reports no progress and performs no work regardless of its inputs.
The above reclaim variant has a fixed zero result.
Memory and swap high overage scans walk ancestors toward but excluding the root and keep the largest scaled overage, with the swap walk emitting an event for any group above its high mark.
Overage is zero at or below the high mark. Above it the excess is precision shifted then divided by the high mark, treating zero high as one.
High delay is zero without overage. Otherwise it grows with the square of overage after precision and scaling reduction, prorated by charge size relative to a nominal batch.

Hierarchical charging adds pages up the ancestor chain under per counter maxima, refreshes protection and watermarks, and on failure unwinds charges below the failing counter and identifies the culprit.
Charging uses atomic addition with ordering against limit changes, racy failure counting, and single access reads and writes for limits and watermarks.
Free area counts used for diagnostics are sampled without locks and marked as intentionally racy.
Observed contiguity info carries total free base pages, total free blocks, and suitable free blocks.

Observed counter state includes usage, maximum, local and global watermarks, configured minimum and low, effective minimum and low, sibling usage totals, parent linkage, and optional failure tracking.
Observed reclaim control includes allocation mode, order, priority, target group, reclaim index, low reclaim flags, proactive flag, and reclaimed versus scanned versus target accounting.
An order above the maximum triggers a once only warning path and yields zero.
Overage and protection math guards division by clamping zero denominators and by checking usage relationships before sharing unclaimed allowance.
Speculative hierarchical charging can briefly overcharge and force a racing smaller charge into early reclaim, bounded by the size difference.
Bulk cache free does nothing for zero size. Sheaved caches use a dedicated path. Other caches repeatedly detach batches and release each nonempty batch.

Sheaved bulk free runs per object hooks in place, compacts out rejected objects, segregates nonlocal objects, drains local objects in batches with slow fallback, then releases remote objects through the slow path with slow accounting.

Sheaf batch insert fails immediately under lock contention. Otherwise it secures room via spare or barn supplied sheaves or full sheaf exchange, copies a bounded prefix, accounts fast frees, and always releases the lock.
Per cpu sheaf access uses a nonblocking local lock. Contention causes immediate fallback rather than waiting.
Bulk slab release runs accounting hooks then a freelist filter and performs the underlying free only when survivors remain, accounting survivors as slow.

Freelist filtering handles a fenced address as a whole batch rejection after one hook, otherwise rebuilds a list of only promptly reusable objects, adjusts the count for delayed objects, and reports success when any survivor exists.
Fenced addresses bypass normal list rebuilding and cause the caller to skip the underlying free.

Per cpu sheaf allocation rejects mismatched explicit node requests and lock contention, refills an empty main, revalidates node affinity, removes one object under lock, and accounts fast and mismatch outcomes.
Sheaf contents are assumed local but migration can break affinity, so node ownership is rechecked and mismatch yields no object.
Single abort resolves the owning slab, runs tagging free handling, and conditionally releases the object through slow slab free.
This post allocation hook variant unconditionally reports success.
Sheaf caching moves among main with room, full main resolved by spare or barn empty supply, and full sheaf exchange, with failure to secure room forcing slow handling.
Observed sheaf state includes per cpu main and spare with sizes and capacity, plus barn level empty supply and full exchange outcomes.
